parameters.query:
SELECT j.id AS job_uuid, j.job_id, j.title, j.company, j.location, j.work_mode,
       j.employment_type, j.job_description, j.description_sha256, j.application_url,
       u.id AS user_id,
       p.target_job_titles, p.years_of_experience, p.technical_skills,
       p.preferred_locations, p.work_modes, p.work_authorization, p.employment_types,
       p.salary_min, p.salary_max, p.salary_currency, p.seniority_levels,
       p.min_match_score, p.max_jobs_per_run, p.scoring_weights,
       r.id AS resume_id, r.content_sha256 AS resume_sha256, r.structured_resume
FROM jobs j
CROSS JOIN users u
JOIN user_preferences p ON p.user_id = u.id
JOIN resumes r ON r.user_id = u.id AND r.is_current = TRUE
LEFT JOIN job_matches jm
  ON jm.job_uuid = j.id
  AND jm.user_id = u.id
  AND jm.description_sha256 = j.description_sha256
  AND jm.resume_sha256 = r.content_sha256
WHERE u.is_active = TRUE
  AND jm.id IS NULL
  AND j.status IN ('discovered', 'evaluated')
ORDER BY j.posted_at DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 15;

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO job_matches (
  job_uuid, user_id, resume_id, description_sha256, resume_sha256,
  overall_match_score, score_breakdown, matching_required_skills,
  missing_required_skills, matching_preferred_skills, relevant_experience,
  potential_eligibility_gaps, uncertain_flags_for_review,
  location_employment_compatibility, reasons_for_score, recommendation,
  qualifies_for_tailoring, llm_model
) VALUES (
  $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7::jsonb, $8::jsonb, $9::jsonb, $10::jsonb,
  $11::jsonb, $12::jsonb, $13::jsonb, $14::jsonb, $15, $16, $17, $18
)
ON CONFLICT (job_uuid, user_id, description_sha256, resume_sha256) DO UPDATE SET
  overall_match_score = EXCLUDED.overall_match_score,
  qualifies_for_tailoring = EXCLUDED.qualifies_for_tailoring,
  evaluated_at = NOW()
RETURNING id AS job_match_id, job_uuid, overall_match_score, qualifies_for_tailoring;
UPDATE jobs SET status = $2, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id, status;
